kpis.description_fr: Revenue Per Available Room (comparable hotels). KPI maître secteur hôtellerie : combine ADR (taux moyen) et occupancy.
kpis.description_en: Revenue Per Available Room (comparable hotels). Master KPI for hospitality: combines ADR (average rate) and occupancy.

kpis.description_fr: Average Daily Rate (ADR) comparable. Pricing power du portefeuille luxe / upper-upscale Host (Marriott, Hyatt, Ritz-Carlton, Four Seasons).
kpis.description_en: Comparable Average Daily Rate (ADR). Pricing power of Host's luxury / upper-upscale portfolio (Marriott, Hyatt, Ritz-Carlton, Four Seasons).

kpis.description_fr: Taux d'occupation comparable. Indicateur de demande absolue (group + transient + corporate).
kpis.description_en: Comparable occupancy rate. Absolute demand indicator (group + transient + corporate).

kpis.description_fr: Adjusted EBITDAre = EBITDA NAREIT-defined ajusté. KPI standard REITs hôtellerie pour comparaison croisée.
kpis.description_en: Adjusted EBITDAre = NAREIT-defined adjusted EBITDA. Standard hospitality REIT KPI for cross-comparison.

_notes: Host Hotels & Resorts = #1 lodging REIT US (81 hôtels luxe/upper-upscale). KPIs spécifiques hospitality REIT : RevPAR + ADR + Occupancy + EBITDAre (le quartet sectoriel standard).

kpis_story.description_fr: Acquisitions d'hôtels luxe et resorts en 2024 (Ritz-Carlton, Four Seasons, Hyatt Regency Reach Key West) : repositionnement luxe / loisir post-COVID.
kpis_story.description_en: Luxury hotel and resort acquisitions in 2024 (Ritz-Carlton, Four Seasons, Hyatt Regency Reach Key West): luxury / leisure repositioning post-COVID.
